tools.name: prokura_request_mandate
tools.description: Ask a human to grant this session a 10-minute demo Prokura Credential. 100.00 EUR per payment, step-up above 50.00 EUR, 150.00 EUR per day. Returns a grant URL and a QR code. Never returns a mandate. Any scope, principal or amount you send is ignored.

tools.name: prokura_check
tools.description: Ask the policy gate whether a payment would be allowed. Nothing is paid.

tools.name: prokura_pay
tools.description: Submit a payment. The policy gate decides allow, step_up (a human approves with a passkey) or deny; only allowed payments are executed, server-side. Give either amount + payee + purpose, or, for an HTTP 402 API, x402Url (the paid response is returned).

tools.name: prokura_evidence
tools.description: Fetch an evidence record by id, or all records of a mandate.

tools.name: prokura_mandate
tools.description: Read a mandate's current state: whether it is active, revoked, expired or not yet valid; its validity window; its scope (currency, per-payment cap, step-up threshold, period cap, allowed rails and purposes, payees); and the budget used so far in the current period (budget, spent, remaining). tools.name: store_quote

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "prokura_mandate" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Read a mandate's current state: whether it is active, revoked, expired or not yet valid; its validity window; its scope (currency, per-payment cap, step-up thre…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: prokura_mandate · Private data: prokura_request_mandate, prokura_evidence · Public sink: prokura_request_mandate, prokura_pay · Destructive: store_catalog, store_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: prokura_mandate · Private data: prokura_request_mandate, prokura_evidence · Public sink: prokura_request_mandate, prokura_pay · Destructive: store_catalog, store_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
